==English==
{{wp|injury}}

===Etymology===
{{root|en|ine-pro|*h₂yew-}}
A {{back-formation|en|injury|nocap=1}}, from {{der|en|enm|injurie}}, from {{der|en|xno|injurie}}, from {{der|en|la|iniūria||injustice; wrong; offense}}, from {{m|la|in-||not}} + {{m|la|ius|iūs, iūris|right, law}}.

===Pronunciation===
* {{IPA|en|/ˈɪn.d͡ʒɚ/|a=GA}}
* {{IPA|en|/ˈɪn.dʒə/|a=RP}}
* {{audio|en|en-us-injure.ogg|a=US}}
* {{rhymes|en|ɪndʒə(ɹ)|s=2}}

===Verb===
{{en-verb}}

# {{lb|en|transitive}} To [[wound]] or cause [[physical]] harm to a living [[creature]].
#: {{syn|en|harm|wound|traumatize|Thesaurus:harm}}
#: {{ux|en|The rugby team's star player got '''injured''' in a violent collision.}}
#: {{ux|en|I injured my '''ankle''' playing tennis.}}
# {{lb|en|transitive}} To [[damage]] or [[impair]].
#: {{syn|en|disfigure|mar|Thesaurus:deface}}
# {{lb|en|transitive}} To do [[injustice]] to.
#: {{ant|en|benefit|help|praise|preserve}}

====Derived terms====
{{col|en|injurable|injurer|reinjure|self-injure}}

====Related terms====
